summary: Very steep narrow street, no-parking signs, house 6 m from the kerb.

drivers.seclusion: Houses line the west side, the nearest 6 m from the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane on a steep hill; no pull-off, kerb-to-fence.
drivers.convention: Two No Parking Any Time signs cover this kerb; a few cars park opposite.

sun_shade: Mixed; trees shade the east side, west is open and house-shaded in the afternoon.
